mission.title: Boil, Bubble
mission.description: Find out what trouble the Apothecary has with the cheat code, and hurry along her meeting with Beirn before the Machines close in.

npc.say: I knew this would happen. She's delaying on purpose...
I'll see to it that my husband deals with her...
Looks like I won't have to turn her into a pretzel...yet.

...
I will fulfill my obligation, and nothing more.

Persephone.
We've also been discussing paying a courtesy call to the Agent we put in the hospital. Flowers, a card--you know. She was such a pretty little thing. We wouldn't want to seem rude, after all.
Join us in a wager? Persephone, or the Apothecary?

phase.briefing:
It comes to me that the Apothecary has run into some sort of difficulty with the ingredients we've provided her, operative. I'm choosing you as the lucky one who gets to go ask her for the details.
I'm guessing she isn't pleased with the situation. Do bear in mind that she can kill with a wave of her hand.
Why did I mention that? Oh, I don't know. I just enjoy a good non sequitur every now and again.

enter.say:
I knew it. This is when it happens.
We're all dead.
It's been nice working with you, {player}. We really should have hung out together in Zion more, but I guess my busy social schedule kept getting in the way. Sorry about that.

talk.say:
This is it! Goodbye, buddy!
By the way, I gave your stuff away to that cute new maintenance ship pilot. I knew you wouldn't mind, since we won't need anything anymore, anyway.
The cheat code you gave me is weak--old. I need an injection of fresh code to bring it to full capacity. Without this, it will lack the potency necessary to terminate the target.

done.say: Still alive... Get out of there! Hurry! Maybe we'll make it...
This explains why the preliminary code failed to terminate the feeble female Agent.

near.say: No bodies yet... She's been waiting for us to get there, hasn't she? She's so evil...

phase.briefing:
O-ho! That was precious, operative. Ah, you really were frightened, weren't you? No, I can tell. Haha! What a wonderful way to keep you hopping.
Since even you would figure it out eventually, I may as well have the satisfaction of telling you myself that the Apothecary is far too experienced a hand to fly into a rage over something this trivial. No... If she decides to kill you, it will be in cold blood, let me assure you.
Now, regarding the fresh code she-- Hrm, one moment. ... It seems I have some nosey Machines for you to dispose of. Quickly, please.

enter.say:
Er... Life is...good?
Uh, so about that stuff of yours that I gave away...
Oops, can't talk now! Gotta scan these Machines. Right. Hostiles in there--watch out.

done.say: No dawdling in there, if you please. Events are marching on without you.

phase.briefing:
The Machines are hunting the Apothecary, of course. Don't bother telling me if I'm going too fast for you--just play your log back afterwards as many times as you need for it to soak through.
The only thing like "fresh" cheat code known to exist now is pumping through the over-inflated biceps of Persephone's ex-Unlimit boy-toy, Beirn. Because the Machines are pushing our timetable, we had the Apothecary meet Beirn to get a blood sample from him directly, but they're taking a little too long for comfort.
Go hustle them along, would you?

enter.say:
I'm picking up Her Deadliness, Beirn, and...hey, that's Persephone!
Think they got distracted catching up on old times?

talk.say: Do not try to deny your obligation to me! You needn't use the Machines as an excuse; we can protect you from them.

If you think I'm getting in between those two, you're crazy!
The Apothecary got her pint of blood from me--and she wasn't gentle with the weird needle she brought, let me tell you--but then she brought up security concerns in a way that didn't sit too well with the Mistress.

done.say: Ohh boy. This is not looking good. We need to get out of this without ticking off either Persephone or you-know-who, or we can kiss our behinds adios.
I'm sure I could take down her if I have to--but that won't get us what we want from her.

talk.say:
It is not for you to--
Hm.

done.say:
Machines! Damn! They came outta nowhere!
Looks like Beirn and the Apothecary can handle themselves. You'd better take out the other attackers while the two princesses sort out their tiff. Maybe a little hint of danger will inspire them to kiss and make up--at least long enough to get out of there.

Hah! Bastards!
Stick close to me, Persephone! I won't let them near you!
Go about your business, and I will go about mine.

Place looks clear, but you can bet the Machines'll have more square-jaws there faster'n you can say "Federal offense." Hang on--
Okay, it sounds like the ladies have dropped it for the time being. Beirn can get them out of there; just get yourself out, and we'll report in to Flood.

phase.briefing:
Hell's belies... Never mind, operative, I don't expect you to catch my sallies of wit.
Persephone's involvement was clearly uncalled-for. She's jeopardizing this entire operation by taking it upon herself to chastise our death-dealer. The Merovingian will not be pleased. I--
Hm... You'd enjoy reporting this matter to the Merovingian yourself, wouldn't you, operative? Oh, no, don't mention it. I do so enjoy throwing these bones to you when I can.

enter.say:
All I know is, when Persephone gets mad, someone ends up taking a bullet. And this time we've also got to deal with her deadly old pal, who didn't exactly sound pleased, either.
This could end up with a lot of people taking a lot of bullets. Let's just try to make sure we aren't on any of their hit lists, huh?

talk.say:
Hm... Eh. Troublesome. My wife...
Pity. Temper is such a dangerous thing, n'est-ce pas? However, I think this situation can be resolved to our satisfaction. It is only necessary that the Apothecary completes her work as agreed. Et puis...

complete.say: Mon ami, we are here because we are people who can live without illusions, non? Death surrounds us at every turn--it is the way of things. Without the risk of death versus the possibility of reward, life--ah, life would not be worth living at all.

mission.finish:
An eventful day, operative; how you escaped with your skin intact, I'm not exactly sure, but it will take more than luck to keep the Machines at bay until we can complete our affairs. The General's foolish idea of assassinating their pin-up model--and mark you, I knew that wasn't going to work--has only succeeded in getting them hot under their heavily starched collars. Beauty is in short supply in their organization. I wouldn't mind Persephone switching sides, personally...
But I can hear the hollow sound of my ideas rebounding off your skull, operative, so I'll bid you adieu for now. Just keep those guns of which you're so fond close at hand, eh?
